about: Place-context mirrors for AquaScope (#520): only datasets whose licence allows redistribution.

dams.attribution: Global Dam Watch database v1.0 (Lehner et al. 2024), CC BY 4.0

ghcn.attribution: NOAA NCEI, Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (via NOAA Open Data Dissemination, CC0)

groundsource.attribution: Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News (Mayo et al. 2026, Google), CC BY 4.0
groundsource.note: lat/lon is the centre of the event's footprint; west..north its bounding box

microsoft_floods.attribution: Microsoft AI for Good Lab global flood dataset (Sentinel-1, 2014-2024), MIT licence
microsoft_floods.note: n = filtered 20 m flood detections in the 0.05 degree cell centred on lat/lon in that month

floods_monthly.attribution: Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News (Mayo et al. 2026, Google), CC BY 4.0; Microsoft AI for Good Lab global flood dataset (Sentinel-1, 2014-2024), MIT licence
floods_monthly.note: news = Groundsource events that started in the month, centred in the cell; radar = filtered Sentinel-1 20 m flood detections in the cell that month
